market_outlook.short_term: Markets face choppy 1-3 month period: Fed hike digestion, BofA-warned pullback, oil volatility, and crypto regulatory uncertainty. Expect S&P 500 to test 7,900 Yardeni target. Treasury yields may push toward 5.2-5.3% before stabilizing. Energy sector leads on LNG/nuclear; tech rotates on AI capex but faces multiple compression.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook constructive for AI infrastructure, nuclear energy, and LNG plays. 5% yield regime normalizes but doesn't break markets (CNBC). China luxury slowdown and global tightening cap broad equity upside. Fed credibility under Warsh supports USD and reduces tail risk. Key question: whether second rate hike materializes, which would pressure equities further.
